digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center rate-limiting (8.6+ DC only, off-by-default) returns 429 with Retry-After header but rebar's transport does not retry it, treating 429 as hard failure
429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only via opt-in flag defaulting to OFF to prevent retrying mutations which risk duplicate writes if the server began processing before returning 429
Retry-After header must be honored with up to 20% jitter applied then clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S, diverging from ADR-0036's connectivity backoff curve which applies jitter only to the default curve

The rate_limit_retry flag must be threaded through two distinct call paths: PATH A via _call_logged (used by _paged_search) and PATH B direct to _with_connection_retry (used by per-issue comment fetch in get_comment_map)
A 429 that exhausts the rate limit must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429, never leaking the raw JIRAError vendor type across the adapter boundary
Retry-After header is read from exc.response.headers not exc.headers; reading the wrong attribute would silently degrade gracefully when no header present but miss retrying when the header exists
